title: 研究 — research; to research
summary: A short passage about research; to research.
summary_en: A short passage about research; to research.

paragraphs.text: 這位專家長期研究人工智能。
paragraphs.hanzi: 這位專家長期研究人工智能。
paragraphs.pinyin: zhè wèi zhuān jiā zhǎng qī yán jiū rén gōng zhì néng 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄓㄜˋ ㄨㄟˋ ㄓㄨㄢ ㄐㄧㄚ ㄓㄤˇ ㄑㄧ ㄧㄢˊ ㄐㄧㄡ ㄖㄣˊ ㄍㄨㄥ ㄓˋ ㄋㄥˊ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Zhè wèi zhuānjiā chángqī yánjiū réngōng zhìnéng.
paragraphs.translation: This expert has long studied artificial intelligence.
paragraphs.translation_en: This expert has long studied artificial intelligence.
paragraphs.translation_id: Pakar ini sudah lama mempelajari kecerdasan buatan.

paragraphs.text: 通過長期觀察，研究人員發現了關鍵規律，從而提高了預測的準確度。
paragraphs.hanzi: 通過長期觀察，研究人員發現了關鍵規律，從而提高了預測的準確度。
paragraphs.pinyin: tōng guò zhǎng qī guān chá ， yán jiū rén yuán fā xiàn le guān jiàn guī lǜ ， cóng ér tí gāo le yù cè de zhǔn què dù 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄊㄨㄥ ㄍㄨㄛˋ ㄓㄤˇ ㄑㄧ ㄍㄨㄢ ㄔㄚˊ ， ㄧㄢˊ ㄐㄧㄡ ㄖㄣˊ ㄩㄢˊ ㄈㄚ ㄒㄧㄢˋ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄍㄨㄢ ㄐㄧㄢˋ ㄍㄨㄟ ㄌㄩˋ ， ㄘㄨㄥˊ ㄦˊ ㄊㄧˊ ㄍㄠ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄩˋ ㄘㄜˋ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄓㄨㄣˇ ㄑㄩㄝˋ ㄉㄨˋ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Tōngguò chángqī guānchá, yánjiū rényuán fāxiàn le guānjiàn guīlǜ, cóng'ér tígāo le yùcè de zhǔnquèdù.
paragraphs.translation: Through long-term observation, the researchers discovered a key pattern, thereby improving the accuracy of the prediction.
paragraphs.translation_en: Through long-term observation, the researchers discovered a key pattern, thereby improving the accuracy of the prediction.
paragraphs.translation_id: Melalui observasi jangka panjang, peneliti menemukan pola kunci sehingga meningkatkan akurasi prediksi.

paragraphs.text: 三年以來，他一直在研究這個問題。
paragraphs.hanzi: 三年以來，他一直在研究這個問題。
paragraphs.pinyin: sān nián yǐ lái ， tā yì zhí zài yán jiū zhè gè wèn tí 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄙㄢ ㄋㄧㄢˊ ㄧˇ ㄌㄞˊ ， ㄊㄚ ㄧˋ ㄓˊ ㄗㄞˋ ㄧㄢˊ ㄐㄧㄡ ㄓㄜˋ ㄍㄜˋ ㄨㄣˋ ㄊㄧˊ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Sān nián yǐlái, tā yìzhí zài yánjiū zhège wèntí.
paragraphs.translation: For the past three years, he has been researching this issue.
paragraphs.translation_en: For the past three years, he has been researching this issue.
paragraphs.translation_id: Selama tiga tahun terakhir, dia telah meneliti masalah ini.

paragraphs.text: 他的研究方法很先進，受到大家的重視。
paragraphs.hanzi: 他的研究方法很先進，受到大家的重視。
paragraphs.pinyin: tā de yán jiū fāng fǎ hěn xiān jìn ， shòu dào dà jiā de zhòng shì 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄊㄚ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄧㄢˊ ㄐㄧㄡ ㄈㄤ ㄈㄚˇ ㄏㄣˇ ㄒㄧㄢ ㄐㄧㄣˋ ， ㄕㄡˋ ㄉㄠˋ ㄉㄚˋ ㄐㄧㄚ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄓㄨㄥˋ ㄕˋ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Tā de yánjiū fāngfǎ hěn xiānjìn, shòu dào dàjiā de zhòngshì.
paragraphs.translation: His research method is very advanced and is valued by everyone.
paragraphs.translation_en: His research method is very advanced and is valued by everyone.
paragraphs.translation_id: Metode penelitiannya sangat maju dan dihargai oleh semua orang.

paragraphs.text: 圖書館新買了兩冊關於環境保護的研究報告。
paragraphs.hanzi: 圖書館新買了兩冊關於環境保護的研究報告。
paragraphs.pinyin: tú shū guǎn xīn mǎi le liǎng cè guān yú huán jìng bǎo hù de yán jiū bào gào 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄊㄨˊ ㄕㄨ ㄍㄨㄢˇ ㄒㄧㄣ ㄇㄞˇ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄌㄧㄤˇ ㄘㄜˋ ㄍㄨㄢ ㄩˊ ㄏㄨㄢˊ ㄐㄧㄥˋ ㄅㄠˇ ㄏㄨˋ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄧㄢˊ ㄐㄧㄡ ㄅㄠˋ ㄍㄠˋ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Túshūguǎn xīn mǎi le liǎng cè guānyú huánjìng bǎohù de yánjiū bàogào.
paragraphs.translation: The library has bought two volumes of research reports on environmental protection.
paragraphs.translation_en: The library has bought two volumes of research reports on environmental protection.
paragraphs.translation_id: Perpustakaan telah membeli dua jilid laporan penelitian tentang perlindungan lingkungan.

paragraphs.text: 這項研究包含大量真實數據，因此結論比較可靠。
paragraphs.hanzi: 這項研究包含大量真實數據，因此結論比較可靠。
paragraphs.pinyin: zhè xiàng yán jiū bāo hán dà liàng zhēn shí shù jù ， yīn cǐ jié lùn bǐ jiào kě kào 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄓㄜˋ ㄒㄧㄤˋ ㄧㄢˊ ㄐㄧㄡ ㄅㄠ ㄏㄢˊ ㄉㄚˋ ㄌㄧㄤˋ ㄓㄣ ㄕˊ ㄕㄨˋ ㄐㄩˋ ， ㄧㄣ ㄘˇ ㄐㄧㄝˊ ㄌㄨㄣˋ ㄅㄧˇ ㄐㄧㄠˋ ㄎㄜˇ ㄎㄠˋ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Zhè xiàng yánjiū bāohán dàliàng zhēnshí shùjù, yīncǐ jiélùn bǐjiào kěkào.
paragraphs.translation: This study contains a large amount of real data, so its conclusion is relatively reliable.
paragraphs.translation_en: This study contains a large amount of real data, so its conclusion is relatively reliable.
paragraphs.translation_id: Penelitian ini berisi sejumlah besar data nyata, sehingga kesimpulannya relatif dapat diandalkan.

title: 项目 — item; project; (sports) event; CL:個|个[ge4]
title_en: 项目 — item; project; (sports) event; CL:個|个[ge4]
summary: A short passage about item; project; (sports) event; CL:個|个[ge4].
summary_en: A short passage about item; project; (sports) event; CL:個|个[ge4].

paragraphs.text: 這個項目需要大量投資。
paragraphs.hanzi: 這個項目需要大量投資。
paragraphs.pinyin: zhè gè xiàng mù xū yào dà liàng tóu zī 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄓㄜˋ ㄍㄜˋ ㄒㄧㄤˋ ㄇㄨˋ ㄒㄩ ㄧㄠˋ ㄉㄚˋ ㄌㄧㄤˋ ㄊㄡˊ ㄗ 。
paragraphs.translation: This project requires a large investment.
paragraphs.translation_en: This project requires a large investment.

paragraphs.text: 感謝你一路支持這個項目。
paragraphs.hanzi: 感謝你一路支持這個項目。
paragraphs.pinyin: gǎn xiè nǐ yī lù zhī chí zhè gè xiàng mù 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄍㄢˇ ㄒㄧㄝˋ ㄋㄧˇ ㄧ ㄌㄨˋ ㄓ ㄔˊ ㄓㄜˋ ㄍㄜˋ ㄒㄧㄤˋ ㄇㄨˋ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Gǎnxiè nǐ yílù zhīchí zhège xiàngmù.
paragraphs.translation: Thank you for supporting this project all along.
paragraphs.translation_en: Thank you for supporting this project all along.

paragraphs.text: 資金不足是這個項目推遲的主要原因之一。
paragraphs.hanzi: 資金不足是這個項目推遲的主要原因之一。
paragraphs.pinyin: zī jīn bù zú shì zhè gè xiàng mù tuī chí de zhǔ yào yuán yīn zhī yī 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄗ ㄐㄧㄣ ㄅㄨˋ ㄗㄨˊ ㄕˋ ㄓㄜˋ ㄍㄜˋ ㄒㄧㄤˋ ㄇㄨˋ ㄊㄨㄟ ㄔˊ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄓㄨˇ ㄧㄠˋ ㄩㄢˊ ㄧㄣ ㄓ ㄧ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Zījīn bùzú shì zhège xiàngmù tuīchí de zhǔyào yuányīn zhī yī.
paragraphs.translation: Insufficient funding is one of the main reasons why this project has been delayed.
paragraphs.translation_en: Insufficient funding is one of the main reasons why this project has been delayed.

paragraphs.text: 項目進入中期以後，資金壓力明顯增加。
paragraphs.hanzi: 項目進入中期以後，資金壓力明顯增加。
paragraphs.pinyin: xiàng mù jìn rù zhōng qī yǐ hòu ， zī jīn yā lì míng xiǎn zēng jiā 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄒㄧㄤˋ ㄇㄨˋ ㄐㄧㄣˋ ㄖㄨˋ ㄓㄨㄥ ㄑㄧ ㄧˇ ㄏㄡˋ ， ㄗ ㄐㄧㄣ ㄧㄚ ㄌㄧˋ ㄇㄧㄥˊ ㄒㄧㄢˇ ㄗㄥ ㄐㄧㄚ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Xiàngmù jìnrù zhōngqī yǐhòu, zījīn yālì míngxiǎn zēngjiā.
paragraphs.translation: After the project entered its middle stage, financial pressure clearly increased.
paragraphs.translation_en: After the project entered its middle stage, financial pressure clearly increased.
paragraphs.translation_id: Akan ada pemeriksaan studi penuh di tengah semester.

paragraphs.text: 兩家公司正在爭同一個項目。
paragraphs.hanzi: 兩家公司正在爭同一個項目。
paragraphs.pinyin: liǎng jiā gōng sī zhèng zài zhēng tóng yī gè xiàng mù 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄌㄧㄤˇ ㄐㄧㄚ ㄍㄨㄥ ㄙ ㄓㄥˋ ㄗㄞˋ ㄓㄥ ㄊㄨㄥˊ ㄧ ㄍㄜˋ ㄒㄧㄤˋ ㄇㄨˋ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Liǎng jiā gōngsī zhèngzài zhēng tóng yí ge xiàngmù.
paragraphs.translation: Two companies are competing for the same project.
paragraphs.translation_en: Two companies are competing for the same project.
paragraphs.translation_id: Dua perusahaan bersaing untuk proyek yang sama.

paragraphs.text: 這個項目規模太大，單靠人力很難完成。
paragraphs.hanzi: 這個項目規模太大，單靠人力很難完成。
paragraphs.pinyin: zhè gè xiàng mù guī mó tài dà ， dān kào rén lì hěn nán wán chéng 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄓㄜˋ ㄍㄜˋ ㄒㄧㄤˋ ㄇㄨˋ ㄍㄨㄟ ㄇㄛˊ ㄊㄞˋ ㄉㄚˋ ， ㄉㄢ ㄎㄠˋ ㄖㄣˊ ㄌㄧˋ ㄏㄣˇ ㄋㄢˊ ㄨㄢˊ ㄔㄥˊ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Zhège xiàngmù guīmó tài dà, dān kào rénlì hěn nán wánchéng.
paragraphs.translation: This project is too large in scale to complete by manpower alone.
paragraphs.translation_en: This project is too large in scale to complete by manpower alone.
paragraphs.translation_id: Proyek ini berskala terlalu besar untuk diselesaikan hanya dengan tenaga manusia.

title: 人员 — staff; crew; personnel; CL:個|个[ge4]
title_en: 人员 — staff; crew; personnel; CL:個|个[ge4]
summary: A short passage about staff; crew; personnel; CL:個|个[ge4].
summary_en: A short passage about staff; crew; personnel; CL:個|个[ge4].

paragraphs.text: 對待安全問題，管理人員必須保持嚴肅態度。
paragraphs.hanzi: 對待安全問題，管理人員必須保持嚴肅態度。
paragraphs.pinyin: duì dài ān quán wèn tí ， guǎn lǐ rén yuán bì xū bǎo chí yán sù tài dù 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄉㄨㄟˋ ㄉㄞˋ ㄢ ㄑㄩㄢˊ ㄨㄣˋ ㄊㄧˊ ， ㄍㄨㄢˇ ㄌㄧˇ ㄖㄣˊ ㄩㄢˊ ㄅㄧˋ ㄒㄩ ㄅㄠˇ ㄔˊ ㄧㄢˊ ㄙㄨˋ ㄊㄞˋ ㄉㄨˋ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Duìdài ānquán wèntí, guǎnlǐ rényuán bìxū bǎochí yánsù tàidu.
paragraphs.translation: When dealing with safety issues, managers must maintain a serious attitude.
paragraphs.translation_en: When dealing with safety issues, managers must maintain a serious attitude.
paragraphs.translation_id: Setelah pertemuan dimulai, ekspresi semua orang menjadi sangat serius.

paragraphs.text: 會議討論了預算以及人員安排。
paragraphs.hanzi: 會議討論了預算以及人員安排。
paragraphs.pinyin: huì yì tǎo lùn le yù suàn yǐ jí rén yuán ān pái 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄏㄨㄟˋ ㄧˋ ㄊㄠˇ ㄌㄨㄣˋ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄩˋ ㄙㄨㄢˋ ㄧˇ ㄐㄧˊ ㄖㄣˊ ㄩㄢˊ ㄢ ㄆㄞˊ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Huìyì tǎolùn le yùsuàn yǐjí rényuán ānpái.
paragraphs.translation: The meeting discussed the budget as well as personnel arrangements.
paragraphs.translation_en: The meeting discussed the budget as well as personnel arrangements.
paragraphs.translation_id: Silakan kirimkan bukti identitas dan dokumen terkait.

paragraphs.text: 申請材料必須充足，否則工作人員可能會要求你補充資料。
paragraphs.hanzi: 申請材料必須充足，否則工作人員可能會要求你補充資料。
paragraphs.pinyin: shēn qǐng cái liào bì xū chōng zú ， fǒu zé gōng zuò rén yuán kě néng huì yāo qiú nǐ bǔ chōng zī liào 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄕㄣ ㄑㄧㄥˇ ㄘㄞˊ ㄌㄧㄠˋ ㄅㄧˋ ㄒㄩ ㄔㄨㄥ ㄗㄨˊ ， ㄈㄡˇ ㄗㄜˊ ㄍㄨㄥ ㄗㄨㄛˋ ㄖㄣˊ ㄩㄢˊ ㄎㄜˇ ㄋㄥˊ ㄏㄨㄟˋ ㄧㄠ ㄑㄧㄡˊ ㄋㄧˇ ㄅㄨˇ ㄔㄨㄥ ㄗ ㄌㄧㄠˋ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Shēnqǐng cáiliào bìxū chōngzú, fǒuzé gōngzuò rényuán kěnéng huì yāoqiú nǐ bǔchōng zīliào.
paragraphs.translation: The application materials must be sufficient; otherwise the staff may ask you to provide additional documents.
paragraphs.translation_en: The application materials must be sufficient; otherwise the staff may ask you to provide additional documents.
paragraphs.translation_id: Materi lamaran harus mencukupi; jika tidak, staf mungkin meminta Anda untuk memberikan dokumen tambahan.

paragraphs.text: 參會人員包括老師、學生及家長。
paragraphs.hanzi: 參會人員包括老師、學生及家長。
paragraphs.pinyin: cān huì rén yuán bāo kuò lǎo shī 、 xué shēng jí jiā zhǎng 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄘㄢ ㄏㄨㄟˋ ㄖㄣˊ ㄩㄢˊ ㄅㄠ ㄎㄨㄛˋ ㄌㄠˇ ㄕ 、 ㄒㄩㄝˊ ㄕㄥ ㄐㄧˊ ㄐㄧㄚ ㄓㄤˇ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Cānhuì rényuán bāokuò lǎoshī, xuésheng jí jiāzhǎng.
paragraphs.translation: Participants include teachers, students and parents.
paragraphs.translation_en: Participants include teachers, students and parents.
paragraphs.translation_id: Para peserta antara lain para guru, siswa, dan orang tua.

paragraphs.text: 人員變動之後，部門之間的責任需要重新劃分。
paragraphs.hanzi: 人員變動之後，部門之間的責任需要重新劃分。
paragraphs.pinyin: rén yuán biàn dòng zhī hòu ， bù mén zhī jiān de zé rèn xū yào chóng xīn huà fēn 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄖㄣˊ ㄩㄢˊ ㄅㄧㄢˋ ㄉㄨㄥˋ ㄓ ㄏㄡˋ ， ㄅㄨˋ ㄇㄣˊ ㄓ ㄐㄧㄢ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄗㄜˊ ㄖㄣˋ ㄒㄩ ㄧㄠˋ ㄔㄨㄥˊ ㄒㄧㄣ ㄏㄨㄚˋ ㄈㄣ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Rényuán biàndòng zhīhòu, bùmén zhījiān de zérèn xūyào chóngxīn huàfēn.
paragraphs.translation: After the personnel changes, responsibilities between departments need to be divided again.
paragraphs.translation_en: After the personnel changes, responsibilities between departments need to be divided again.
paragraphs.translation_id: Setelah terjadi perombakan personel, pembagian tugas antar departemen perlu diatur ulang.

paragraphs.text: 領導來參觀時，工作人員紛紛要求和他合影。
paragraphs.hanzi: 領導來參觀時，工作人員紛紛要求和他合影。
paragraphs.pinyin: lǐng dǎo lái cān guān shí ， gōng zuò rén yuán fēn fēn yāo qiú hé tā hé yǐng 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄌㄧㄥˇ ㄉㄠˇ ㄌㄞˊ ㄘㄢ ㄍㄨㄢ ㄕˊ ， ㄍㄨㄥ ㄗㄨㄛˋ ㄖㄣˊ ㄩㄢˊ ㄈㄣ ㄈㄣ ㄧㄠ ㄑㄧㄡˊ ㄏㄜˊ ㄊㄚ ㄏㄜˊ ㄧㄥˇ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Lǐngdǎo lái cānguān shí, gōngzuò rényuán fēnfēn yāoqiú hé tā héyǐng.
paragraphs.translation: When the leader came to visit, the staff members all asked to take a group photo with him.
paragraphs.translation_en: When the leader came to visit, the staff members all asked to take a group photo with him.
paragraphs.translation_id: Ketika pemimpin itu datang berkunjung, para staf pun meminta untuk berfoto bersama dengannya.
